topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Hey, I just heard about what happened. Listen, I know this has to be tough. It’s a shock when someone’s not being straight with you, especially when it’s about something as big as their job. But you’ve gotta remember, lies usually come from a place of fear or feeling trapped, not from a place of wanting to hurt you. I think talking it out might help both of you clear the air. I’m here for you, no matter what you decide to do. Just give it some time, and do what feels right for you, okay?
